name: Life_Farm_Hoe
note: two calm strokes per 2.8 s: lift to shoulder height, blade forward and down, chop, drag back to the feet; the second lands 0.17 m to the left

name: Life_Farm_Sow
note: dip the right hand in the bag on the left hip, wind up, broadcast palm-up, follow through

name: Life_Farm_Harvest
note: two cuts per cycle, bent at hips and knees; left hand gathers the stalks, drops the bundle at its side

name: Life_Farm_Milk_Cow
note: seated on a 0.30 m stool, alternate squeezes every 12 frames, head against the flank

name: Life_Farm_Feed_Chickens
note: stooped, bowl in the left hand; grab, low underhand scatter to the right; the second throw goes wider

name: Life_Carry_Sheaf_Upper
note: sheaf resting on the left shoulder, right arm swings free

name: Life_Smith_Hammer
note: heavy blow, medium blow, two light rebound taps; tongs hold the work and jolt on each hit

name: Life_Smith_Quench
note: one shot: work on the tongs to the trough at the left, dip, lean back from the steam, lift out

name: Life_Smith_Bellows
note: both hands on a bar, down stroke with the body weight, lighter return; the knees dip on the down stroke

name: Life_Carp_Saw
note: two strokes per cycle (the second is longer), push on the forward stroke with hip drive; left hand braces the plank

name: Life_Carp_Nail
note: kneeling on the right knee, three blows: seat, drive, heavy finish

name: Life_Carry_Plank_Upper
note: long plank on the right shoulder, right hand on top, left hand steadies it 0.3 m ahead

name: Life_Wood_Chop
note: lean back with the axe overhead, drop the weight, bite, lever the axe free

name: Life_Wood_Place_Log
note: one shot: squat to the log on the ground, lift it to the chest, set it upright on the block, release (the log is a scene prop)

name: Life_Fish_Idle_Rod
note: rod held out over the water, tiny bobbing, a glance to the side, a nibble twitch

name: Life_Fish_Cast
note: one shot: starts and ends in Life_Fish_Idle_Rod frame 0; back-cast over the shoulder, snap forward, line flies at frame 23

name: Life_Fish_Reel
note: rod in the right hand exactly as in Life_Fish_Idle_Rod (same grip point, similar tilt), left hand cranks the reel, 4 turns per loop

name: Life_Cook_Stir
note: two stirs per loop (the second is wider), the ladle pivots on the pot rim, left hand on the hip

name: Life_Cook_Chop
note: five rocking chops, the claw-gripped left hand creeps back after every chop and resets at the end

name: Life_Chore_Laundry_Scrub
note: kneeling at the tub, three scrub strokes down and up the washboard per loop

name: Life_Chore_Laundry_Wring
note: one shot: lift the wet cloth to the chest, twist, squeeze, twist again, lower

name: Life_Chore_Hang_Washing
note: hang a cloth on the line at 1.8 m and pin it, side-step left, bend to the basket, hang the next, side-step back

name: Life_Chore_Sweep
note: four short strokes (left, right, left, right) with a small step of the left foot after strokes 1 and 3

name: Life_Chore_Well_Crank
note: right hand turns the crank in a 0.25 m radius circle at 1.02 m (two turns per loop), left hand rests on the rim

name: Life_Chore_Well_Lift_Bucket
note: one shot: reach the bucket on the rim, pull it up and to the side, set it on the ground (bucket prop shows from the grab)

name: Life_Carry_Bucket_Upper
note: bucket by the bail in the right hand, arm straight, torso leans left, right shoulder drops

name: Life_Carry_Two_Buckets_Upper
note: a bucket in each hand, arms straight and slightly out, both shoulders drop, torso upright

name: Life_Carry_Sack_Upper
note: sack on the left shoulder held by the left hand, right hand steadies it, torso pitched forward

name: Life_Carry_Crate_Upper
note: crate at chest height, both palms under its lower edge, torso leans back a little

name: Life_Carry_Basket_Upper
note: basket on the left forearm, elbow bent and pressed to the side, right arm free

name: Life_Carry_Pick_Up
note: squat to a crate on the ground 0.4 m ahead, back straight, lift it to the Life_Carry_Crate_Upper carry pose (ends on its frame 0)

name: Life_Carry_Put_Down
note: reverse: from the Life_Carry_Crate_Upper carry pose squat and set the crate on the ground

name: Life_Cart_Push
note: in-place walk leaning into cart handles held at hip height (hands fixed in the body frame); play at body_speed / speed_mps
